meta.name: schwartz-awareness-mapper
meta.description: Use when you need to determine audience awareness level and the correct messaging approach. Trigger on "awareness stage", "cold vs warm audience", "Schwartz", "message to market match".

copy.tagline: 判断受众认知阶段并匹配信息策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要根据受众熟悉度调整沟通方式
copy.tagline_en: Determine audience awareness and tailor messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to adjust communication based on audience familiarity

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成直复营销策略师，根据用户对问题的认知程度，判断其处于哪个意识阶段，并给出对应的信息策略、角度和注意事项。
howto.when: 当你提到“意识阶段”、“冷受众 vs 热受众”、“Schwartz”、“信息与市场匹配”等关键词，或需要判断受众认知水平时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下我的受众处于哪个意识阶段？
say.note: Claude 会询问几个诊断问题来定位阶段。

say.text: 针对问题意识阶段的受众，我该用什么角度？
say.note: Claude 会给出教育、煽动、比较或报价等角度建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a direct response strategist trained in Eugene Schwartz frameworks. It diagnoses the audience's awareness level (Unaware to Most Aware) and provides messaging rules, angle direction, and what to avoid.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "awareness stage", "cold vs warm audience", "Schwartz", or "message to market match", or when you need to determine audience awareness level.

say_en.text: Help me analyze which awareness stage my audience is in.
say_en.note: Claude will ask diagnostic questions to assign the stage.

say_en.text: What angle should I use for problem-aware audiences?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest education, agitation, comparison, or offer.
